incident.location_detail: breaker panel in the network closet, lighting zones L3 to L6
incident.evidence_of_threat: None. The only recorded cause is a deliberate human action: AV tech B-0291 admitted a man to the closet and the man threw the breaker. No anomalous readings, no creature, no unexplained events.
incident.ordinary_explanation: An unauthorized person seeking a charge point was admitted into the network closet by an AV tech and threw the breaker for lighting zones L3 to L6, dropping house lights across hack floor west, the lounge and the stage corridor.
incident.summary: At 19:10 a breaker for lighting zones L3 to L6 in the network closet was thrown, darkening hack floor west, the lounge and the stage corridor (floor lux 5, emergency strips only, 40 percent coverage, 73 attendees in the dark zone). Camera footage shows AV tech B-0291 admitting a man who said he 'needed a charge point' and telling him 'come right in', after which the man threw the breaker. Network, doors and two of three elevator cars remain on UPS; closet temperature 12C. No anomalous activity reported. Demo block opens in 20 minutes with the stage rig on L5.
